————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, the April 22, 2002/Vaisakha 2, 1924 (Saka)

(Ministries :  Development of North-Eastern Region; Disinvestment;
Health and Family Welfare; Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises;
Information and Broadcasting; Law, Justice and Company Affairs;
Shipping; Social Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs;
Urban Development and Poverty Alleviation)
Total number of questions—20
122
Disposal of pending cases by retired
judges
*401. SHRI K. KALAVENKATA
RAO: Will the Minister of LAW, JUSTICE
AND COMPANY AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether a group of retired judges of
Patna High Court has offered to return to
the bench to assist the court to dispose of
over 100,000 pending cases; and
(b) if so, Government's response in this
regard?
Facilities in hospitals
*402. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item captioned
"Facilities in hospitals exist only on paper:
panel", which appeared in the Hindu, dated
the 18th March, 2002;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
and
(c) the steps proposed to be taken to
implement the recommendations of the
Parliamentary Committee to provide quality
medical facilities in the various medical
institutes and hospitals of Government?
Infrastructural development of towns/
cities in Tamil Nadu
*403. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of URBAN DEVELOPMENT
AND POVERTY ALLEVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of towns/cities in Tamil
Nadu which have been allocated financial
assistance for infrastructural development;
(b) whether there is any proposal to
include Andipatti/Theni towns in Tamil
Nadu for infrastructural development;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Non-existent voters' names in West
Bengal
*404. DR. ARUN KUMAR SARMA:
Will the Minister of LAW, JUSTICE AND
COMPANY AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the CEO of
West Bengal detected seventy lakhs non-

existent voters' names as reported in the
Statesman, Kolkata edition, dated the
5th February, 2002;
(b) if so, the details thereof and status of
those indicating their existence, citizenship
status, modus operandi adopted for their
inclusion in the list and implication on the
Assembly Poll, 2001 results;
(c) the steps taken to prevent such
happening in future; and
(d) the reported incidents of such
finding, if any, in other States including
Assam?
Model Land Use Policy for urban
areas
*405. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT AND POVERTY
ALLEVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to formulate a Model Land Use Policy for
urban areas to meet the aspirations of the
economically weaker sections;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when the Model Land Use Policy
is likely to be brought before the Parliament?
Hostels for SC/ST students
*406. SHRI C.O. POULOSE: Will the
Minister of TRIBAL  AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) the total number of hostels for
SC/ST students in the country, State-wise;
(b) the number of students availing the
facility in the country, State-wise;
(c) whether Government propose to
construct more number of hostels; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Budgeting nightmares for cancer
patients
*407. SHRI SATISH PRADHAN: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item captioned,
"Have some sympathy, Mr. Sinha-Budgeting
nightmares for cancer patients", which
appeared in the Indian Express, dated the
15th March, 2002; and
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto and the corrective steps taken or
proposed to be taken in this regard?
Report on National Cancer Research
Programme
*408. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the National
Cancer Research Programme has been
entrusted to the National Institute of Health
and Family Welfare;
(b) if so, whether the Institute has
submitted its report on the evaluation of the
programme; and
(c) if not, the reasons for the delay?
Cereal Banks in villages
†*409. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
set-up Cereal Banks in the villages;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) in what manner it will help to provide
food security to the villagers, particularly
poor villagers?

Withdrawal of Insurance cover
2924. SHRI INDRAMONI BORA:
Will the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
insurance cover has been withdrawn by
Insurance Companies in Barak-Valley (three
districts Silchar, Karimganj, Harilakandi)
Dhubri and Lakhipur revenue circle of
Goalpara districts; and
(b) if so, whether he would take up the
matter with Finance Minister so that
insurance cover for the above districts is
restored immediately?
Industrial development of Assam
2925. SHRI DRUPAD BORGOHAIN:
Will the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) the policy adopted to develop Assam
in the Industrial field;
(b) whether there is any new proposal to
establish new industries in the State;
(c) whether there is any concrete proposal
to open new commercial routes and improve
the old ones with neighbouring countries of
North-Eastern Region of the country; and
(d) the manner which Government
propose to accelerate the mechanised
cultivation in Assam to reduce the
unemployment?
No taker for ITDC hotels
2926. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of
DISINVESTMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the proposed
sale of ITDC hotels has no takers;
(b) if so, whether it is a fact that ITDC
has prepared a report on making the
disinvestments attractive; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Non-availability of buyers for PSUs
2927. SHRI N. K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of
DISINVESTMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether any Public Sector
Companies set apart for disinvestment stand
referred back due to non-availability of
buyers;

639
WIN2\SESSION\189RS 639
(b) if so, the details thereof and how
many among them are making heavy losses;
(c) whether any such companies are
located in Kerala; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Plan for restructuring and
disinvestment of sick
PSUs
2928. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of DISINVESTMENT be pleased
to state:
(a) the names of sick public sector
undertakings which are proposed to be
privatised during the current year and the
funds likely to be generated as a result
thereof;
(b) whether Government have
formulated any plan to effectively restructure
and disinvest the sick PSUs; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Redressal of grievances of employees of
PSUs to be disinvested
2929. PROF. M. SANKARA-
LINGAM: Will the Minister of
DISINVESTMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has set-up any
cell in regard to improving the
communication with employees of PSUs
which are on the verge of privatisation;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) the number of grievances of the
employees and concerns of shareholders of
the privatised PSUs that have come to the
notice of the cell; and
(e) the complete details of redressal of
such grievances?
Disinvestment of MOIL
2930. SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM: Will
the Minister of DISINVESTMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Manganese Ore India
Limited (MOIL) is under the process of
disinvestment;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether the Trade Union of MOIL
has submitted any proposal to take over the
PSU instead of disinvestment; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
response of his Ministry in this regard?
Formulation of Schemes for Family
Welfare Programme
†2931. PROF. R. B. S. VARMA: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
contemplating to formulate schemes for
Family Welfare Programme;
(b) if so, the details of these schemes;
and
(c) the amount allocated for
implementation of these schemes?
Hot spots of HIV in the country
2932. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the National AIDS Control
Organization (NACO) has identified
districts in the country as hot spots of HIV;
(b) if so, the names of the districts so
identified;
(c) the action plan drawn to effectively

State Governments and NGOs; and
(d) the total financial assistance given to
National AIDS Control Organisation for the
last three years and work done by them?

bio-technology
